prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a lively wedding reception scene filled with distinct characters and objects. On the left side of the composition, a bride in a white gown stands holding a bouquet of pink roses, while next to her, a groom in a black tuxedo smiles broadly at the guests. A small brown dog sits calmly on the floor near the couple's feet, looking up expectantly. In the center foreground, a round table covered with a blue cloth holds a multi-tiered white cake, which is being cut by an older woman in a purple dress using a silver knife. Beside the cake, a young boy in a blue suit reaches out to touch the frosting, guided gently by the hand of a man in a red scarf who stands nearby. To the right, a band performs on a low stage where a drummer in a leather jacket plays vigorously behind a kit, and a singer in a gold dress holds a microphone close to her mouth. An audience member in a green shirt claps enthusiastically from a chair in front of the stage. Behind the main group, a waiter in a white apron carries a tray of champagne glasses, walking past a tall potted plant with broad green leaves. A photographer in a beige vest kneels on one knee to capture the moment, aiming a large camera lens at the cake-cutting pair. Hanging from the ceiling above are strings of yellow fairy lights that stretch across the room. A stack of wrapped gifts in colorful paper rests against the wall near the entrance. There is no rain visible through the windows, and there is no smoke rising from any source. The bride looks at the groom, who is standing next to the brown dog. The older woman in the purple dress is handing the knife toward the cake. The young boy in the blue suit is looking at the cake. The man in the red scarf is pointing at the boy. The singer in the gold dress is looking at the audience. The drummer in the leather jacket is sitting on a stool. The audience member in the green shirt is sitting on a chair.
